latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video Free — Convert Images Into Video Clips.

- Instantly turn up to three JPG product photos into 1080p MP4 video clips via chat.
- No manual video editing: just upload images and describe your desired outcome.
- Fully cloud-based with fast processing (30–60 seconds per export).
- Automatic session and token setup included; 100 free credits on first use.
- Supports export, credits check, balance, and progress/status queries.
- Error handling for token expiry, missing credits, unsupported files, and more.
